name: icon
description: A small picture from the app's icon pack, or an inline SVG. Hidden from screen readers unless it has a label. An app uses one pack: it imports one packs/*.css file and calls setIconPack() from glyph.js with the same pack, which defaults to material-symbols.

props.name: The icon's name in the app's pack, like settings. material-symbols: it becomes the text, which the font draws. Supports every modifier with packs/material-symbols-variable.css, and size and weight with packs/material-symbols.css. phosphor: it becomes classes, like ph ph-smiley. Supports size, with one CSS file per style: thin, light, and bold weights, fill, and duotone. tabler: ti ti-settings. Supports size and fill. feather: fi fi-feather. lucide: li li-banana. Both support size only. Plain HTML: write the text or the classes.
props.duotone: Phosphor only: a two-tone icon. Uses ph-duotone in place of ph. Needs packs/phosphor-duotone.css.
props.children: An inline <svg> in place of a name, for SVG icon sets. Web component and plain HTML: write it inside.
props.label: Text for screen readers. Adds role="img" and aria-label. With no label, the icon gets aria-hidden="true".
props.size: small, medium, large, or x-large. Adds icon--small, icon--medium, icon--large, or icon--x-large. Medium is the default.
props.weight: thin, light, normal, semi-bold, or bold. Adds icon--weight-thin, icon--weight-light, icon--weight-normal, icon--weight-semi-bold, or icon--weight-bold.
props.emphasis: low, normal, or high. Adds icon--low-emphasis, icon--normal-emphasis, or icon--high-emphasis.

modifiers.icon--outlined: The default fill: an outline only
modifiers.icon--filled: Fills the shape. Tabler uses a separate filled icon in place of this modifier
modifiers.icon--low-emphasis: Slightly thinner lines on a font icon. Lower opacity on an SVG icon
modifiers.icon--high-emphasis: Slightly thicker lines on a font icon. No change on an SVG icon

customPropertiesNote: Fill, grade, and optical size need a font with those axes, like the full Material Symbols variable font. Other packs set their own font family and ignore them and --op-icon-font-family. An SVG icon follows the size, color, and SVG variables. Its stroke width changes only with a weight modifier, so with none it keeps the widths it was drawn with.

icon.--op-icon-weight: Font weight and the wght axis
icon.--op-icon-fill: The FILL axis: 0 for an outline, 1 for filled
icon.--op-icon-grade: The GRAD axis, set by the emphasis modifiers
icon.--op-icon-optical-size: The opsz axis, set by the size modifiers to match the size
icon.--op-icon-stroke-width: Stroke width of an SVG icon, set by the weight modifiers
icon.--op-icon-svg-opacity: Opacity of an SVG icon, set by icon--low-emphasis
